name: Marvell Technology
description: Marvell is a fabless supplier of data-infrastructure chips: custom ASICs (AI and cloud accelerators built to a customer's design), optical and electrical interconnect chips and DSPs, ethernet switches and adapters, storage controllers and processors. Data center is now 74 percent of revenue (79 percent in the quarter ended 2026-08-01), with the rest in communications and other (enterprise networking, carrier infrastructure, consumer). It sold its automotive ethernet business to Infineon for $2.5B in August 2025 and in February 2026 bought Celestial AI (photonic interconnect) and XConn (PCIe/CXL switches). One customer was 14 percent and one distributor 37 percent of FY2026 revenue.

hq.note: 1000 N. West Street, Suite 1200, Wilmington, DE 19801 per FY2026 10-K (Delaware corporation; operations in Santa Clara, California and many other countries). Wikipedia S&P list shows Santa Clara, California (see conflicts).

employees.note: 7,480 people: 49% Americas, 42% APAC including India, 9% EMEA (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Data center
businessLines.how: Mostly custom silicon and interconnect chips sold per unit to a few hyperscalers and equipment makers; custom ASICs involve customer-funded design work followed by volume shipments, so revenue depends on a handful of AI programs.
businessLines.description: Cloud and on-premises AI systems and servers, ethernet switching, storage and data-center interconnect: custom ASICs, electro-optics (PAM and coherent-lite DSPs), ethernet and PCIe/CXL interconnect, storage controllers.

businessLines.name: Communications and other
businessLines.how: Chips sold per unit to networking and carrier equipment makers and consumer-device makers; cyclical and shrinking share of the mix.
businessLines.description: Enterprise networking (campus routers, switches, wireless access points), carrier infrastructure, consumer and (until August 2025) automotive/industrial; four earlier end markets were merged into this line in Q4 FY2026.
